facades.name: kaptol_klet
facades.source: Street View Jul 2024 (pano 2 Kaptol, rectified from 2 frames); halves stitched
facades.look: a two-storey Baroque-classicist town house in soft butter-yellow plaster on the west side of Kaptol, six bays: on the upper floor six tall windows with white frames and shallow triangular white hoods, set between flat white pilasters, a white stringcourse under them and a plain white eaves cornice; the ground floor is cream: at the LEFT a white stone-framed segmental arched entrance with a dark timber door and above its door the white letters 'KAPTOLSKA KLET' on a dark panel, a black menu board and an old street lantern to its left, then smaller square white-framed windows at ground level, and further right the plain cream wall with more small square windows (the real front is hidden behind café umbrellas and planters: continue it plainly). Copy exactly, the only text is 'KAPTOLSKA KLET'. Draw NO people, NO parked cars, NO trees, NO street furniture, NO map interface overlay, NO round map icons.

Small black iron cross-shaped wall anchors are visible. No text. Draw NO people, NO parked cars, NO trees, NO street furniture, NO map interface overlay, NO round map icons.

facades.look: a long two-storey Baroque town house (Kurija Tome Kovačevića) in grey-blue stucco with white plaster pilasters, window frames and raised ornamental panels: at the LEFT end a wide segmental-arched stone portal with a rusticated stone frame and a closed dark door, above it a balcony with a white stone balustrade and two stone ball finials and a tall balcony window, then a long run of tall upper windows with white frames and shallow panels between them on the RIGHT, the ground floor below with grey rusticated panels and tall barred windows; a lamp post and a hanging flower basket and a blue sign stand in front (leave them out).
